title: FOMC Minutes Show Near-Consensus for Further Hikes; Waller Says a Half-Point Move May Be Needed
detail: Minutes of the October FOMC meeting, released Nov 18, showed nearly all participants judged further rate increases would likely be appropriate under their baseline outlooks, with some discussion of disappointing returns on AI investment. Governor Christopher Waller said a half-point hike is likely needed in December and that the Fed may have to "shock people," saying he is "very, very concerned about inflation."

media.caption: Treasury yields and Fed hike expectations after FOMC minutes and Waller remarks
